concept.title: Scenario: naming a complex topic
concept.shortdesc: Documentation for an industrial company’s training manual, contains a topic where the source heading is

conbody.p: Documentation for an industrial company’s training manual, contains a topic where the source heading is "Refilling the Cullet Heater Using Procedure A for Plant 50667821".

This heading is too long and too specific for a filename. Apply these transformations:
Identify the core action: refilling the cullet heater
Remove unnecessary specifics: procedure letter, plant number
Apply prefix: t_ for task
Use underscores: t_refill_cullet_heater.dita

section.title: Result
section.note: If the plant-specific information is genuinely needed, include it in the topic title and metadata, not in the filename.
